capabilities_done: (1) Folio records (409fa22): StudioCompositionLayer gains serde-default three_d (position_z, anchor_z, rotation_x, rotation_y, orientation as keyed values; material options with accepts_lights/accepts_shadows/casts_shadows/appears_in_reflections flags, bevel style/direction and every STU-MOT-014 member by name), camera (zoom, point_of_interest, depth_of_field, iris_shape, the STU-CMP-040 members by name) and light (light_type parallel/spot/point/ambient, colour + profile ref, intensity, falloff_type, casts_shadows, background_visible, environment_atom, point_of_interest, STU-CMP-045 members by name). Absent members are not encoded (byte-identical). Authored bounds table STUDIO_3D_BOUNDS (STU-CMP-046: bounds are explicit, intensity unbounded and may be negative, zoom 1..1e6 px); camera_angle_of_view / camera_zoom_of_angle (one value, two views). Refusals: camera or light without three_d, camera and light on one layer, unknown member names, out-of-bound values, bad keyframes.

(2) composite three_d (409fa22): 3D layer = plane mapped to the screen by one homography (rotation Rz Ry Rx after orientation, exact quarter turns); camera one-node (own rotation) or two-node (look-at point of interest, then own rotation), default camera z = 0 maps 1:1; per-pixel depth from the exact inverse homography; a run expands into one rank-matted projective layer per (depth rank, plane): farthest first, ties by stack order, so intersecting planes cut each other per pixel; renders on both renderers through the corner-pin machinery (SceneContent::Pinned + coverage matte).

(3) adapter (409fa22, 1db8951): contiguous 3D layers form runs; a 2D or adjustment layer breaks the run and three_d_run_breaks() surfaces each break (STU-CMP-035a); topmost visible camera active at the tick; camera and light layers draw nothing. Typed refusals: composition_3d_parent (3D layer with a parent, 2D layer under a 3D parent), composition_3d_layer_option (track matte, mask path, corner pin, clipping on a 3D layer), composition_3d_content (adjustment or collapsed precomp as 3D), composition_3d_camera_degenerate, composition_3d_plane_crosses_camera, composition_3d_run_limit (> 32 planes).

(4) PLANAR_RENDERER capability set (STU-CMP-060): extrusion, bevels, curvature, subdivision, reflections, refraction, environment lighting, shadow diffusion and light colour profile conversion declared not honoured, each with its reason (shown inactive).

(5) lights and materials (b937713, slice 2): SceneContent::Lit = content rendered over its rect, shaded per texel by three_d::shade, placed like a tile, so both renderers resample it unchanged. Model (Studio reading): ambient lights add colour x intensity; point/spot/parallel add Lambert diffuse and Phong specular (exponent 1 + shininess %), smooth / inverse-square-clamped falloff, spot cone with feather, metal tints the specular by the albedo; result clamped into the unit sample range, intensities never clamped (negative lights subtract). Hard shadows: casters of the same run along the segment to the light, nearest-texel caster alpha x opacity x (1 - light transmission) x darkness. No light in the composition = unlit. Adapter samples light and material streams (Folio defaults from STUDIO_3D_BOUNDS), lights active by window and visibility.

(6) STU-CMP-045a diagnostic (b937713): three_d::shadow_switches_off names light_casts_shadows_off / caster_casts_shadows_off / receiver_accepts_shadows_off; CompositionTemporalSource::three_d_shadow_diagnostics lists every (light, caster, receiver) triple in one run with some but not all switches on (bounded 65536 triples, BudgetExceeded before work). 3D layers on the document-graph path are refused composition_3d_on_document_graph.
